in_arabic.name: شهرز
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مدينة في بلاد فارس القديمة، ومعناه النجم الملكي أو الملك النجمي، وله أهمية في التراث الإسلامي والثقافة الفارسية

in_urdu.name: شاہروز
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایک پرانے فارس کی شہر کا نام، جس کا مطلب ہے شاہی ستارہ یا ستارہ شاہی، اور اسے اسلامی روایت اور فارسی ثقافت میں اہمیت حاصل ہے

in_hindi.name: शाहरोज
in_hindi.long_meaning: प्राचीन फारस के एक शहर का नाम, जिसका अर्थ है शाही तारा या तारा शाही, और इसका महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा और फारसी संस्कृति में है

in_pashto.name: شاہروز
in_pashto.long_meaning: د پخواني فارس د ښار نوم، چې معنا يې شاہي ستوري يا ستوري شاہي دی، او دا نوم د افغان/پښتو دود İz اسلامي روایت کې ځانګړی اهمیت لري

in_english.name: Shahroz
in_english.long_meaning: name of an ancient Persian city, meaning royal star or star king, and it has significance in Islamic tradition and Persian culture, symbolizing royalty and celestial guidance

data.cultural_impact: The name Shahroz has a rich history and cultural significance for many people, particularly those with Islamic and Persian heritage. The first part of the name, "Shah," reflects the historic and traditional power and prestige of the rulers and leaders of the Islamic and Persian empires. The name signifies leadership, authority, and strength. The second part of the name, "Roz," means "light" or "shining," suggesting brightness, knowledge, and intelligence. In this way, the name reflects the aspirations for a strong, capable, and intelligent leader.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic and Persian religious and spiritual traditions, the name Shahroz takes on additional layers of meaning. The name signifies the belief in the divine sovereignty and wisdom of God as the ultimate ruler and light. The name may also reflect the spiritual quest for illumination, knowledge, and understanding. Additionally, in Sufi (Islamic mysticism), the pursuit of Shahroz represents the pursuit of the magical, hidden light in every being, which helps them to transform and grow spiritually. Ultimately, the name Shahroz carries a message of both worldly and spiritual power, leadership, and enlightenment.
